omni.assessment: About 4 wrong details: a V instead of Y on the cap in 2 frames, an invented kitchen with people talking, a purple wall instead of purple light. Slightly more specific than Qwen2.5-VL (names the white Y in 12 frames against 6, and once correctly puts the red trim on the chair). Loaded through the desktop runtime as runtime/worker.py does (fp16 on MPS): 17 s load, 3.6 s per frame, 9.7 GB peak. Script: experiments/model-trial/omni_frames.py

conclusion: Qwen2.5-VL 3B and Omni 3B are about equally accurate on frames; Qwen2.5-VL is 1.6 times faster, needs about a third of the memory, and runs in the built-in engine without the optional desktop runtime. Omni stays reserved for joint audio and video inspection.
